sourceScope.note: Final vendor sources match ordered-target-2 and ordered-transitions-1/2 core binaries. Final diagnostic host and wrapper sources match ordered-transitions-2. Earlier host builds differ by added metadata, geometry guards, transition checks and the corrected CGFloat assertion. Actual binary hashes are per case. Parent published the identical vendor sources as ae579755614cd8a0edf7c6f9d94c0095c7d26216 after capture; no binaries changed for publication.

implementation.scaleObservation: Value is specified by the source call; CAEDRMetadata has no public optical-scale getter. Runtime report observes object presence/description, actual pixel format, colour space, EDR enablement and target range.
ordering: pl_swapchain_resize with zero dimensions completes pending colour recreation; unchanged is mutex-only
short explicit VO-thread Core Animation transaction assigns fresh metadata if changed
implementation.threading: Renderer owns retained layer and metadata under MRC. No per-frame synchronous AppKit dispatch; screen/profile/backing callbacks increment a locked revision and request expose. No CA lock spans Vulkan or main dispatch.
implementation.mapping: Default linear target preserves source peak/range and normal Vulkan BT2020-linear format selection; Core Animation receives reference-white-consistent display metadata. No PASS_THROUGH request, new swizzle, alpha conversion or additional automatic203-nit target mapping. Explicit user target options retain their meaning.
implementation.failureHandling: Missing layer/colour space rejects initialization; invalid range/failed recreation cannot claim external success; actual contract or metadata-allocation failure clears owned metadata and returns false with a bounded warning.

validation.originalHLGNote: This MoltenVK surface selection renders originalHLG through a PQ target with fresh1000-nit metadata; it does not expose an HLG CAMetalLayer in this case. OriginalSDR selects ITUR709 and nil HDR metadata.
